title: Updates and what's new
summary: The app checks for new versions when it opens and in the background, installs them at startup, and after each update shows what changed.
usage: When the app opens, a short screen checks for a new version and, if there is one, updates and restarts; without a network, the app opens after 10 seconds. If a version is found later, a bar offers What changes and Update now. To stop updating on open, go to Settings › App › Version. The full history is in What's new, in Ctrl+K and on the site's Release notes page.
